bugs: A ProcessWorkspaceShell component test reflectively invoked the obsolete Boolean approval signature and did not seed pending approvals; it now proves typed mixed decisions reach the orchestrator unchanged.
A PluginsPage bUnit test dispatched a stale event-handler id across an asynchronous render; event lookup and dispatch now occur on the renderer synchronization context.
deviations: The monolithic Integration command exceeded 15 minutes without a failure. All 120 discovered classes were then covered exactly once by six deterministic class shards, producing 723 passes and one explicit live-provider skip.
knownGaps: The live local Ollama installed-model test is skipped unless CANDOITALL_RUN_LIVE_OLLAMA_VALIDATION=true and the required model catalog already exists; the test explicitly forbids model downloads.
